name: REAL IMAGE WATER MOTION

r3_stage_d_root_cause.summary: Stage D was a hard-coded nine-band Canvas2D overlay, not a continuous bounded deformation of the Z1 lake surface. It had no authoritative lake mask or static-anchor exclusions and its source sampling was sparse one-dimensional strip replacement.
verified_by: R3 phone result: A/B/C visible, D failed to prove real-image motion
R3 Stage D code: fixed 230x135 clip, nine horizontal drawImage bands, no Z1 geometry or boundary field

renderer.why_selected: R3 proved Canvas2D presentation on the target phone. It is the simplest available path that can directly resample the approved photographic pixels while keeping non-water pixels fixed.
renderer.offscreen_buffer_justification: One source pixel buffer and one rasterized geometry-mask buffer are required for bounded image resampling.

pixel_deformation.method: Full source ImageData copy followed by localized water-only bilinear resampling
pixel_deformation.field: Independent dx/dy multi-scale field with four spatial components, nested phase variation, spatial phase variation, and temporal rates 0.31, 0.57, 0.93, and 1.37 radians/second
pixel_deformation.sample_guard: When a displaced bilinear footprint leaves the water mask, displacement is reduced to 52%, then 20%, then falls back to the original pixel.

boundary_attenuation.distance_field: Bounded 8-neighbor raster distance field built once per internal-resolution change
boundary_attenuation.falloff: Smoothstep over approximately 15 design pixels; displacement reaches zero at the water-mask boundary
boundary_attenuation.outside_mask_behavior: Output pixels are copied from the untouched source buffer

runtime.scene_clock: one SceneClock with retained monotonic elapsed time
runtime.background_recovery: Pending RAF is cancelled while hidden; foreground resumes from retained elapsed time with a new delta anchor and no silent elapsed reset.

remaining_risks: Z1 authored boundaries still require real-phone visual inspection.
Canvas2D ImageData cost may vary by Android browser and thermal state.
Bounded internal resolution may be softer than the untouched static reference.
Proof amplitude is intentionally exaggerated and is not a final naturalism claim.
No code counter or context result is treated as a phone visual PASS.
phone_test_procedure: Serve the repository root so the relative authoritative image path resolves.
Open the R4 HTML artifact at the established target phone viewport.
Inspect the default untouched Static Reference.
Tap PROOF WATER to enable strong motion and start/resume the SceneClock.
Judge actual photographic lake texture deformation in the open-water center.
Check that shoreline, island, waterfall edge, wood, and rocks remain anchored.
Use PAUSE and STATIC REFERENCE for comparison; use DEBUG GEOMETRY only for mask inspection.
Record phone visual result and diagnostics; stop after R4.
